proves: The device's checksum covers bytes 0..45 including the HIDC trailer. A packet whose checksum was computed over bytes 0..41 only is rejected with result 0x02, even though the HIDC bytes themselves are intact.

request.checksumAlgorithm: LE16 sum of bytes 0..45 inclusive (HIDC included)

notes: This is the only difference from the accepted baseline; payload bytes are identical, so 0x02 is attributable solely to the checksum coverage.
